scientific_hypothesis: More breeding-space amount reduces signed coupling to the shared species-wide forcing.
A_only_model: Use the unchanged spatially adjusted V3 engine with H and A:H columns fixed to zero; lambda_i = 1 + alpha_block + gamma_A * A_centered_within_block + b_i.

inference.scheme: Within each species and frozen V3 spatial block, permute A among site time series; refit the complete A-only V3 model for every permutation.
inference.species_multiplicity: Holm adjustment across ADPE, CHPE, GEPE
inference.global_index_rng: For species index s and global permutation index k, use numpy SeedSequence([20260929,k,s,101]); the extra fixed tag separates H1 permutations from the primary A:H permutation stream.
inference.sharding_note: Sharding is computational only. The inferential object is the fixed set of 9999 global permutation indices; shard count does not change any permutation or p-value.

H_only_secondary.model: same V3 engine with A and A:H fixed to zero
H_only_secondary.reporting: point estimates only; no directional inferential claim because the design does not specify a context-free sign for H

terrain_R: not inferentially opened; nonzero R recovery was not frozen pre-outcome
interpretation_guardrails: This secondary H1 cannot replace or reclassify the non-confirmatory primary A:H permutation result.
If A-only is supported, describe simple breeding-space buffering separately from the suggestive option-fragmentation interaction.
No new paper-level pooled A test is introduced.
execution_repair_note: Initial shards completed successfully; the first aggregate failed because exact JSON float equality was used for independently recomputed observed fits. Aggregation was repaired to require numerical equality at 1e-10 tolerance without rerunning or changing any permutation.
